kind.description: browser, or the app's name from its X-LawFive-Device header (garmin).

name.description: For people: "Garmin Venu 2" ("Garmin watch" when it didn't say which), "Chrome on macOS".

model.description: A watch's Garmin part number, "006-B3703-00", when it gives one.

firmware.description: A watch's firmware version, "12.30", when it gives one.

appVersion.description: The version of LawFive on it (VER-3), "2026.10.30", from the app= in its X-LawFive-Device header; missing for browsers and apps from before it.

linkedAt.description: When it signed in or was linked.

current.description: true for the device making this request.

watchOnly.description: true for a watch's link, which only syncs matches (SEC-13); absent for everything else.

description: Somewhere the account is signed in: a browser or a linked watch.
